facts.fact: LTA Commissioner Angela Cassell Bush said Liberia's IXP, hosted by the Cable Consortium of Liberia (CCL) in Monrovia area, remains functional, though governance problems and limited ISP participation persist and many ISPs are not yet peering there; the date is the document's published date, as the page shows none.
